source: Onkelos on Exod 35:1-3; the docket row Mishnah Sanhedrin 4:1
claim_en: Moses ASSEMBLES the whole congregation, and before one board is cut the Sabbath is re-issued — a Sabbath of Sabbath BEFORE the LORD, the worker put to death — with ONE labor singled out in the ink: you shall not KINDLE FIRE in all your dwellings on the Sabbath day (Onkelos Exod 35). The precedence rule carried by the order of the clauses (the tabernacle work never overrides the day — EX31-03's join restated at the execution side), and the singled fire-labor waits on the case shelf (Mishnah Sanhedrin 4:1, this exam's docket: the court that does not burn on the Sabbath).

Take from among yourselves a set-apart offering BEFORE the LORD — everyone whose heart is WILLING shall bring (Onkelos Exod 35): the voluntariness clause on every line of the materials census, the Terumah call re-enacted in execution voice with the full parts-list read back.

source: Onkelos on Exod 35:20-24; the crowding at Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 11:2
claim_en: The hard preposition of 35:22 — Hebrew 'the men came UPON the women' — rendered by the received translation AND THE MEN BROUGHT IN ADDITION TO THE WOMEN: the additive reading, both sexes giving with the men's gifts riding on the women's (Onkelos Exod 35); the spine reads the same verse as the CROWDING — men and women pressing in one eager throng (Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 11:2). Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.

Every WISE-HEARTED woman spun WITH HER HANDS; the goats-hair spinners' hearts moved them WITH WISDOM (Onkelos Exod 35) — the same wisdom-tokens that fill Bezalel applied to the women's spinning: the craft-spirit is not gendered in the ink.

source: Onkelos on Exod 35:27-29; the missing letter at Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 11:4 with 11:3
claim_en: The leaders bring the stones — and the spine reads the ink: because they were SLOW (waiting to fill whatever the people left short), the leaders' word is written DEFECTIVE at 35:27, one letter yod short of its full spelling (Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 11:4); the people had brought everything in TWO MORNINGS — the doubled morning-word counted — and the willing were shut out by the halt, the leaders left to underwrite the garments and stones (Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 11:3). An ink-level spelling claim, opened in full. Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.
